name: 生成视频
description: 仅在用户明确要求最终视频时调用。使用员工配置的 video_model_id 提交异步视频任务，返回 jobId；后续必须使用 check_video_generation 查询。
inputSchema: {"type":"object","properties":{"prompt":{"type":"string","description":"完整视频生成提示词"},"duration":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":15,"default":5},"resolution":{"type":"string","enum":["480p","720p","1080p"],"default":"720p"},"aspect_ratio":{"type":"string","enum":["9:16","16:9","1:1","3:4","4:3"],"default":"9:16"},"image_url":{"type":"string","description":"可选首帧图片 URL，只允许平台 /uploads/ 路径或 HTTPS"},"generate_audio":{"type":"boolean","default":true}},"required":["prompt"]}
